operations.title: The physical d=3 radial boundary is the equatorial S2 of the q_G vanishing S3
operations.body: The radial Rees equation restores the lower Gram term and yields omega^2=det(G)-vhat^T adj(G)vhat, whose real vanishing cycle is S3. In physical d=3 the external span is full, the Schur complement ell_perp^2 vanishes, and the source chain lands at omega=0, the equatorial S2. It does not canonically choose a full oriented S3 generator.

operations.title: Exact block-Gram radial-Rees boundary audit
operations.body: Exact rational Gram/adjugate identities verify K=det(G) ell_perp^2 and the physical d=3 equatorial condition.
